name: git-log-still-needs-a-plan
description: Was an allow fixture until 2026-08-19. git left the read-only allowlist on 2026-08-19: with a matching '.gitattributes' attribute and a diff/filter/fsmonitor driver in config, git runs a program of the repository's choosing with no flag asked for, so an allowlisted git would be arbitrary execution the gate had blessed. 'git log -p' runs the textconv driver as readily as 'git diff' does.
